items.title: Haiti Turns to Roger Stone To Lobby Trump Administration
items.summary: The Haitian government hired Mr. Stone, a confidant of President Trump, weeks after hundreds of thousands of Haitians lost deportation protection. The contract is worth nearly $800,000, a document shows.

items.title: U.N. Updates: Netanyahu Lashes Out at Critics and Underscores Threats to Israel

items.title: Carney Says He Would Consider a Second Term, Depending on State of U.S.-Canada Relations

items.title: Police in Poland Arrest Ukrainian Citizen Over Fatal Stabbing
items.summary: The police arrested a Ukrainian citizen on suspicion of carrying out the knife attack, which came as the two countries are trying to steady relations soured by old antagonisms.

items.title: Saudi Arabia Downs Houthi Missiles Targeting Kingdom, Official Says
items.summary: The Iran-backed militia in Yemen fired six ballistic missiles at Saudi cities, a military spokesman said. It was a major cross-border attack.

items.title: Forced Eviction of 87-Year-Old Woman Spurs Outrage in Spain
